items.title: AI Spending Fears Hammer Big Tech Stocks
items.content: Bloomberg Senior Editor for Technology and Strategic Industries Mike Shepard tells Bloomberg This Weekend that disappointing Big Tech earnings are intensifying investor concerns about whether massive AI spending will generate sufficient returns, as Alphabet and Intel come under particular pressure. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Lisa Mateo, Shepard also discusses the record $6.3 billion Binance hack and the possibility that North Korean hackers were responsible. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Bloomberg Senior Editor for Technology and Strategic Industries Mike Shepard tells Bloomberg This Weekend that disappointing Big Tech earnings are intensifying investor concerns about whether massive AI spending will generate sufficient returns, as Alphabet and Intel come under particular pressure. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Lisa Mateo, Shepard also discusses the record $6.3 billion Binance hack and the possibility that North Korean hackers were responsible. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 科技巨头AI支出引发投资者担忧，大公司股价承压。彭博科技战略产业高级编辑Mike Shepard表示，因AI投入巨大，Alphabet和Intel等公司业绩不佳，加剧了投资者对其能否获得足够回报的疑虑。他还提及Binance遭6.3亿美元黑客攻击，并讨论了朝鲜黑客的可能性。（来源：彭博）
summaries.en: Big Tech stocks face pressure due to fears that massive AI spending will yield insufficient returns, with Alphabet and Intel under particular scrutiny. Bloomberg Senior Editor Mike Shepard highlights investor concerns amid disappointing earnings. Additionally, the record $6.3 billion Binance hack is discussed, with North Korean hackers potentially responsible. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Binance in Talks for Malaysia License after Five-Year Absence
items.content: Binance said it’s in discussions with Malaysian regulators for a licensed business in the country, as the cryptocurrency exchange seeks a route back into a market where authorities have blocked its website and applications.
items.contentSnippet: Binance said it’s in discussions with Malaysian regulators for a licensed business in the country, as the cryptocurrency exchange seeks a route back into a market where authorities have blocked its website and applications.
items.creator: Suvashree Ghosh

summaries.en: Binance is in talks with Malaysian regulators to obtain a license for its operations in the country after a five-year absence. The cryptocurrency exchange, which previously faced restrictions with blocked website and apps, is seeking to re-enter the Malaysian market. The discussions aim to secure legal authorization for its business activities.

items.title: SoftBank-Backed OPay Halts IPO to Respond to Regulatory Inquiry
items.content: OPay Ltd., a Nigeria-focused payments platform, halted an initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange that was supposed to start trading on Friday, citing a regulatory inquiry.
items.contentSnippet: OPay Ltd., a Nigeria-focused payments platform, halted an initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange that was supposed to start trading on Friday, citing a regulatory inquiry.
items.creator: Loni Prinsloo and Julia Fioretti

summaries.zh: 软银支持的尼日利亚支付平台OPay宣布暂停在纽约证券交易所的首次公开募股，理由是监管机构正在展开调查。
summaries.en: OPay Ltd., a Nigeria-based payments platform backed by SoftBank, has suspended its initial public offering (IPO) on the New York Stock Exchange. The company cited a regulatory inquiry as the reason for the halt, which was originally scheduled to begin trading on Friday. The decision was made to respond to the inquiry, ensuring compliance with relevant authorities. No further details were provided about the nature of the inquiry or its potential impact on future plans.

items.title: The Betting Coup That Rocked London’s Bookmakers Goes Unsolved
items.content: Lisa Lazarus, the top cop in US horse racing, woke up one morning this summer to find a flurry of missed overseas calls and e-mails. They were all from UK regulators and they all delivered the same urgent message: a series of large, unusual and suspiciously successful wagers on US races had been placed in London the day before, saddling some of the city’s famed betting parlors with hefty losses, and they needed her help.

summaries.zh: 美国赛马首席警官丽莎·拉扎勒斯近日收到英国监管机构的紧急通知。前一天，伦敦多家知名博彩店因遭遇一系列金额巨大、异常成功且可疑的投注而遭受重创，损失惨重。监管机构要求她协助调查此事。目前，事件起因尚未查明。
summaries.en: A series of large, suspiciously successful bets on US horse races were placed in London, causing significant losses for local bookmakers. UK regulators alerted Lisa Lazarus, the top US horse racing cop, who received urgent overseas calls and emails. The betting spree, which targeted US races, overwhelmed London betting parlors and required her assistance to investigate. The incident remains unsolved.

items.title: OpenAI’s Altman Meets Samsung Executives as Chip Crunch Deepens
items.content: OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman met with Samsung Group’s top executives in South Korea on Saturday to deepen cooperation on memory chips and AI infrastructure as global shortages intensify.

items.title: OpenAI Funding Target Cut by $10 Billion as AI Slumps, FT Says
items.content: OpenAI has cut its fundraising target by $10 billion as an AI stock selloff and rival Anthropic PBC’s impending public listing complicate its efforts to secure investor commitments, the Financial Times reported.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI has cut its fundraising target by $10 billion as an AI stock selloff and rival Anthropic PBC’s impending public listing complicate its efforts to secure investor commitments, the Financial Times reported.
items.creator: Yoolim Lee

summaries.zh: 据《金融时报》报道，OpenAI因人工智能股票抛售和竞争对手Anthropic即将上市而缩减了10亿美元的融资目标，导致其难以获得投资者承诺。
summaries.en: OpenAI has reduced its fundraising target by $10 billion due to declining AI stock values and competition from rival Anthropic PBC's upcoming public offering, according to the Financial Times. The company's ability to secure investor commitments has been challenged by these market conditions.

items.title: Meta’s Rating Outlook Cut to Negative by S&P on AI Spending
items.content: S&P Global Ratings took an early step toward potentially downgrading Meta Platforms Inc.’s credit rating within the next two years, amid growing pressure on the tech company’s balance sheet stemming from elevated spending tied to artificial intelligence.

summaries.en: S&P Global Ratings cut Meta Platforms Inc.’s AA- credit rating outlook to negative, citing rising pressure on the company’s balance sheet due to increased spending on artificial intelligence. The downgrade reflects concerns about the financial impact of Meta’s AI initiatives.

items.title: Bridgewater CEO Nir Bar Dea on AI Investing, Markets and Leadership | The David Rubenstein Show
items.content: Bridgewater Associates CEO Nir Bar Dea sits down with David Rubenstein for a wide-ranging conversation about the US economy, rising national debt, the dollar and explains how he sees AI reshaping the future of investing. He also reflects on his unconventional path to Wall Street; from struggling in school and spending six years in the IDF to becoming Bridgewater's oldest intern and eventually its CEO. He's on this week's episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations. This interview was recorded September 25 in New York.  (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: NYSE Owner Plans Hyperliquid Perpetuals Market in US
items.content: Intercontinental Exchange joined forces with one of the market operators behind offshore crypto-trading platform Hyperliquid as it seeks to bring perpetual futures products into US regulated markets. ICE and Trade.xyz are planning a new market for trading perpetual futures contracts, with its own clearing, know-your-customer and anti-money laundering systems. Jeff Sprecher, Intercontinental Exchange Founder, Chair and CEO, joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the agreement, plus Friday's major tech selloff,  the growing demand for perpetual futures trading, and more. Sprecher speaks with Tim Stenovec and Jess Menton.  (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Intercontinental Exchange joined forces with one of the market operators behind offshore crypto-trading platform Hyperliquid as it seeks to bring perpetual futures products into US regulated markets. ICE and Trade.xyz are planning a new market for trading perpetual futures contracts, with its own clearing, know-your-customer and anti-money laundering systems. Jeff Sprecher, Intercontinental Exchange Founder, Chair and CEO, joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the agreement, plus Friday's major tech selloff,  the growing demand for perpetual futures trading, and more. Sprecher speaks with Tim Stenovec and Jess Menton.  (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 美东时间周二（3月13日），洲际交易所（ICE）与加密货币交易平台Hyperliquid运营商Trade.xyz合作，计划在美国推出Hyperliquid永续合约市场。该市场将拥有独立的清算、了解你的客户（KYC）和反洗钱（AML）系统。ICE创始人兼首席执行官杰夫·斯普雷特（Jeff Sprecher）就协议、科技股大跌、永续合约需求增长等问题与彭博商业周刊进行了讨论。
summaries.en: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) is partnering with Trade.xyz to launch a new market for trading Hyperliquid perpetual futures contracts in the US. The market will operate under regulated clearing, know-your-customer (KYC), and anti-money laundering (AML) systems. ICE Founder and CEO Jeff Sprecher discussed the agreement, the tech selloff, and the growing demand for perpetual futures trading in a Bloomberg interview. The collaboration aims to bring perpetual futures products into the US regulated market.

items.title: Need To Rethink How AI Infrastructure Is Powered: FuelCell Energy CEO
items.content: FuelCell Energy President and CEO Jason Few discusses public concerns over higher utility bills, water use and fossil-fuel infrastructure. Discussing a proposed project in Newport Township, Pennsylvania, where FuelCell Energy would supply power but is not the developer, Few said communities should have a say and projects should be judged on their actual effects—not rejected simply because they are data centers. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

Discussing a proposed project in Newport Township, Pennsylvania, where FuelCell Energy would supply power but is not the developer, Few said communities should have a say and projects should be judged on their actual effects—not rejected simply because they are data centers. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: FuelCell Energy首席执行官Jason Few指出，公众对高昂的电力账单、水资源消耗和化石燃料基础设施表示担忧。他讨论了宾夕法尼亚州纽波特镇的一个项目，FuelCell Energy将提供电力但非开发商，强调社区应参与决策，项目应基于实际影响而非仅因数据中心身份被否决。Few在Bloomberg的"The Close"节目中与Romaine Bostick和Kristine Aquino对话。(来源：Bloomberg)
summaries.en: Jason Few, CEO of FuelCell Energy, addresses public concerns about rising utility bills, water use, and fossil-fuel infrastructure. He advocates for community input on proposed AI projects, like the one in Newport Township, Pennsylvania, emphasizing that such projects should be evaluated based on their actual impacts rather than being dismissed solely as data centers. Few argues for a reevaluation of how AI infrastructure is powered, highlighting the need for balanced assessments. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Illumina CEO on Q3 Results and Business Outlook
items.content: Jacob Thaysen says Illumina delivered a strong third quarter, beat expectations and raised its fourth-quarter outlook. He said the company has moved from essentially flat performance to mid-single-digit growth over the past 18 months and remains committed to its high-single-digit growth target for 2027, with clinical business serving as the main growth driver. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Why Electronic Arts Shut Down BioWare And Cancelled ‘Mass Effect’
items.content: Facing financial pressure, the video-game publisher chose ‘Star Wars’ over ‘Mass Effect’
items.contentSnippet: Facing financial pressure, the video-game publisher chose ‘Star Wars’ over ‘Mass Effect’
items.creator: Jason Schreier

summaries.zh:
《为什么电子艺界关闭了生物界并取消了《质量效应》》  
由于财务压力，这家游戏发行商选择将资源投入《星球大战》系列，而非《质量效应》。电子艺界决定关闭生物界工作室，并取消了《质量效应》后续项目。这一决策反映了公司对市场优先级的调整，将重点转向更具商业潜力的《星球大战》。
summaries.en: Electronic Arts shut down BioWare and cancelled *Mass Effect* due to financial pressure. The publisher prioritized *Star Wars* over the *Mass Effect* franchise. The decision reflects EA's strategic shift toward focusing on the *Star Wars* IP amid budget constraints.

items.summary:

items.title: Tech Stocks Tumble as AI Fears Collide With Earnings Misses
items.content: Tech stocks plunged on Friday for the second day in a row as fears around AI spending collide with disappointing earnings in big tech’s core businesses.

summaries.en: Tech stocks are expected to fall for a second consecutive day following Amazon's report of higher-than-anticipated capital spending and the slowest growth in its core e-commerce business in three years. The increased investment in AI has raised concerns, contributing to the market decline.

items.title: Apple Overtakes Nvidia to Become World’s Most Valuable Company
items.content: Apple Inc. reclaimed the title of world’s most valuable company on Friday, taking the mantle from Nvidia Corp. as investors seek the perceived safety of the iPhone maker amid concerns about artificial intelligence spending.
items.contentSnippet: Apple Inc. reclaimed the title of world’s most valuable company on Friday, taking the mantle from Nvidia Corp. as investors seek the perceived safety of the iPhone maker amid concerns about artificial intelligence spending.
items.creator: Jeran Wittenstein and Ryan Vlastelica

summaries.zh: 苹果公司于周五重新夺回全球最有价值公司的称号，取代英伟达公司。投资者因对人工智能支出表示担忧，转而寻求苹果公司所代表的相对安全。
summaries.en: Apple Inc. surpassed Nvidia Corp. to reclaim the title of the world's most valuable company on Friday. The shift reflects investor preference for Apple's perceived stability amid growing concerns about excessive spending on artificial intelligence. The company's market value now surpasses Nvidia's, marking a significant change in the tech industry's leadership.

items.title: Intel Suffers Worst Stock Drop in Decades on Weak Forecast
items.content: Intel Corp. suffered its worst stock rout in more than four decades after the PC industry slump and supply-chain snags hurt its forecast, renewing fears about the chipmaker’s turnaround bid.

summaries.en: Intel's shares dropped sharply in late trading as its revenue forecast fell short of analyst expectations. The decline was driven by weakened demand for PC processors and supply chain issues affecting its profitable data center components.

items.title: Big Tech Holds $3 Trillion in Spending Commitments for AI Boom
items.content: The five largest players in the data center race have committed more than $3 trillion in spending over the coming years, pointing to massive ongoing investment in AI infrastructure.

summaries.en: Big Tech companies are set to invest over $3 trillion in AI infrastructure in the coming years.
